attributes.name: ais-monitoring
attributes.description: AIS maritime monitoring & distress watch

attributes.title: Vessels Seen
attributes.description: Per-MMSI rollup: name, call sign, flag, type, message count, max SOG, last-seen.

attributes.title: Vessel Coverage (Bearing × Distance)
attributes.description: Polar heatmap of position-message density vs observer-relative bearing and distance.

attributes.title: AIS Distress Events Over Time
attributes.description: Counts of ais.distress.is_distress=true bucketed by time.

attributes.title: AIS Distress Events
attributes.description: SART / MOB / EPIRB beacons, NavStatus AIS-SART, or safety messages with distress keywords.

attributes.title: AIS Single-Message Anomalies
attributes.description: Spoof / sentinel / kinematic-impossibility flags raised at ingest.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query": {"language": "kuery", "query": "ais.anomaly.navstatus_speed_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.heading_cog_disagree: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_invalid_range: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_envelope_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_category_message_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_suspicious_pattern: true OR ais.anomaly.identity_changed: true OR ais.anomaly.null_island: true OR ais.anomaly.sog_implausible_high: true"}, "filter": [], "indexRefName": "kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}

attributes.title: Active Vessels (15m)
attributes.description: Distinct MMSIs broadcasting position in the last 15 minutes.

attributes.title: Messages (15m)
attributes.description: Total AIS messages ingested in the last 15 minutes.

attributes.title: Anomalies (15m)
attributes.description: Distinct MMSIs flagged by any single-message anomaly.

query.query: ais.anomaly.mmsi_invalid_range: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_envelope_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_category_message_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_suspicious_pattern: true OR ais.anomaly.identity_changed: true OR ais.anomaly.null_island: true OR ais.anomaly.sog_implausible_high: true OR ais.anomaly.navstatus_speed_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.heading_cog_disagree: true

attributes.title: Distress (1h)
attributes.description: Distinct MMSIs in distress state in the last hour.

attributes.title: Max Range (nm)
attributes.description: Greatest observed vessel range from the receiver.

attributes.title: Feed Lag p95 (s)
attributes.description: 95th-percentile delay between AIS event time and bridge ingest.

attributes.title: Message Rate by Class
attributes.description: AIS message count over time, split by message class.

attributes.title: Ship Type Categories
attributes.description: Distinct vessels in the AOR by ship_type_category.

attributes.title: Top Flag Countries
attributes.description: Distinct vessels by MMSI MID-derived flag country.

attributes.title: Navigation Status Mix
attributes.description: Distinct vessels by navigation status (position reports only).

attributes.title: Anomalies by Type
attributes.description: Distinct vessels affected per single-message anomaly.

attributes.title: Distress by Source
attributes.description: Distinct vessels in distress, broken out by detection source.

attributes.title: Active Vessels
attributes.description: All vessels with a position report in the current time window. Click any value (flag, type, nav status, etc.) to pin it as a dashboard filter.

attributes.title: Suspicious Identity
attributes.description: Vessels with placeholder, mismatched, or invalid MMSIs — primary AIS-deception tell.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query": {"language": "kuery", "query": "ais.anomaly.mmsi_suspicious_pattern: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_category_message_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_invalid_range: true OR ais.anomaly.mmsi_envelope_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.identity_changed: true"}, "filter": [], "indexRefName": "kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}

attributes.title: Kinematic Inconsistency
attributes.description: Vessels reporting nav-status / speed / heading combinations that don't add up — behavioral spoof or sensor failure indicators.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query": {"language": "kuery", "query": "ais.anomaly.navstatus_speed_mismatch: true OR ais.anomaly.heading_cog_disagree: true OR ais.anomaly.sog_implausible_high: true"}, "filter": [], "indexRefName": "kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}

attributes.title: Aids to Navigation Off-Position
attributes.description: Aids to Navigation (AtoN) reporting themselves as drifted (off-position) or marked virtual — nav hazards and potential spoofing indicators.

attributes.title: AIS Operational Watch
attributes.description: Sector-watch view: vessel population, type and flag mix, nav-status, single-message anomalies, suspicious-identity & kinematic-inconsistency watchlists, active distress, AtoN drift.
